Plugin.Name: Intel GPU Firmware (Alpha)
Plugin.Overview:
Public alpha for inspecting Intel GPUs and installing compatible newer GSC firmware using official Intel IGSC. Downloads a reviewed Intel firmware package on request, verifies hashes, records firmware history and checks Intel release information. Installation and plugin updates never flash automatically.
Updates require a supported host Intel driver and MEI interface, a compatible newer image, prepared GPU maintenance and explicit confirmation of the exact card. After approval, only affected Docker containers and VMs are stopped and their normal managed starts blocked; privileged containers are included. Unrelated running workloads remain running. Unsupported GPU access, including native LXC access, blocks maintenance.
Tested host: Unraid 7.4.1 / x86_64. One ASRock Arc A380 was physically updated with an earlier developer build and verified after reboot. Other vendors, generations, multi-GPU systems and passthrough restoration are unvalidated; detection does not guarantee update support. A live reboot test of the new maintenance guard integration is pending.
GSC only: no GPU BIOS, OPROM, firmware-data or HDMI updates, arbitrary firmware uploads, forced flashing, downgrades or recovery guarantee. An interrupted or failed update can leave the GPU unusable. A UPS is recommended but optional. Allow about 2.1 GB of temporary space for firmware staging.
